title: Performance Improvement Request Form
subtitle: Use this request to route the need, test readiness, document review, authorize a bounded action, and verify implementation for a performance improvement workflow.
description: An original operational performance improvement request form that controls a objective performance-support and review record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the manager, employee, or HR case owner needs a traceable request so the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer can start, revise, extend, complete, close, or escalate the performance-improvement process under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Performance Improvement request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable request and identify the responsible reviewers before work begins.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, initiating event, business need, affected people or work, and explicit exclusions

sections.title: Requested performance improvement scope and operating need
sections.guidance: Describe the exact requested action and the evidence needed to evaluate it.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement request type
items: Clarify an objective job-related performance expectation
Create a focused support and improvement plan
Correct incomplete, inaccurate, late, or inconsistent work output
Address a documented conduct or reliability standard
Provide coaching, training, tools, workload clarification, or feedback
Set a checkpoint after prior informal feedback
Revise or extend an active plan based on documented evidence
Route an accommodation, protected-activity, or policy concern separately

blocks.label: Operational reason, intended result, assumptions, dependencies, alternatives, and timing impact

sections.title: Performance Improvement readiness, policy, and impact review
sections.guidance: Confirm the request can be reviewed without bypassing privacy, safety, security, or authority controls.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement readiness checkpoints
items: Current job description, essential outputs, and applicable standards are identified
Each concern cites objective examples, dates, impact, and source evidence
Employee response and supporting information are preserved
Prior expectations, coaching, feedback, and opportunities are documented
Targets and measures are specific to the identified performance gap
Resources, training, tools, access, priorities, and manager support are assigned
Checkpoint schedule gives timely feedback before final review
Accommodation or medical information is routed to a separate confidential process
Retaliation, complaint, leave, or protected-activity concerns receive independent review
Comparable application and conflict-of-interest checks are complete
Checkpoint conclusions use evidence from the defined review window
Final action has qualified HR review and a documented handoff

blocks.label: Request and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This request does not itself authorize action. The qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer must apply the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements, resolve exceptions, and record any conditions before implementation.

sections.title: Performance Improvement review, alternatives, and decision
sections.guidance: Compare the request to the governing evidence and document why the selected route is appropriate.

blocks.label: Requirement, evidence, finding, and decision matrix
Evidence considered, alternatives rejected, approved limits, exception treatment, and communication plan

sections.title: Approved performance improvement implementation and exception handoff
sections.guidance: Translate the decision into owned work without losing a condition or system update.

blocks.label: Approved action, condition, system update, and completion evidence
Implementation and communication controls
items: Concern is supported by objective, job-related evidence
Expectation and measure are clear and consistently applied
Employee response and contrary evidence received fair review
Resources, training, tools, and manager support are feasible
Accommodation and protected-activity indicators have independent routing
Review period and checkpoints allow meaningful feedback
Manager conflict and comparable-treatment checks are complete
Qualified HR reviewer approved the process, conditions, and communication

blocks.label: Implementation variance, failed dependency, changed fact, immediate action, and reapproval need

sections.title: Performance Improvement request completion and closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when the implemented result, remaining limits, and receiving ownership are verifiable.

blocks.label: Open performance improvement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance

fields.label: Qualified Hr, Employee-Relations, Legal, Or Management Reviewer / date
